target_customer: Software developers who run coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor Agent and want them next to their PRs, docs, terminals and localhost servers
problem: Developers juggle coding agents, terminals and browser tabs in separate windows, and the agents cannot see or act on the browser workspace.
business_model: Free macOS browser using the user's existing agent subscriptions; no paid model found

founders.name: Quentin Romero Lauro
founders.background_notes: YC page lists years of HCI work at CMU

competitors.name: Cursor web app for agents
competitors.what: Web dashboard to manage a network of coding agents from a browser, not a browser built for agents
competitors.traction_then: Cursor was the leading AI IDE, no figures captured

technical_complexity.rationale: A Chromium based macOS browser with agent integrations is standard engineering with some hard parts (embedding agents, giving them page access), built by a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Free product built on Chromium and other vendors' agents; Cursor and others could add browser panes, and no data or network effect is evident.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cursor shipped a web agent manager in June 2025 and Anthropic put Claude Code on the web in October 2025 per search results; the effect on Radius is not public.

market_need_then: Rapid adoption of coding agents in 2025 created demand for tools that coordinate several agents in parallel next to the browser context developers already use. No hard spend figures found.

branding.domain_note: Uses radiusbrowser.com, not radius.com, which belongs to an unrelated company

identity.visual_style: Decorative dithered visuals per the company site
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, confident, product focused headlines such as Everything is a tab

rebrands.why: Not stated; Inspector launched via Launch YC in 2025-11 as an AI IDE for front end per a YC launch page
Not stated; dated only by a secondary profile (yespress.io), which says the Inspector site redirected to Radius by 2026-08

branding.community_and_virality: Site links a Discord community and changelog; no press about the brand found.

brand_strength.rationale: Three names in a short time, a generic name that collides with other Radius products, and no brand press found.

pivots.from: Inspector, AI IDE for front-end development
pivots.to: A browser for orchestrating coding agents (Sol, then Radius)

outcome_analysis: Radius is a very young Fall 2025 company that moved from an AI front end IDE to a developer browser in under a year and renamed twice. No funding, traction or exit is public. The wedge sits in a space where Cursor and Anthropic ship agent management features quickly, so competition and differentiation are the main open questions.
notes: Funding unverified: yespress.io reports a 130K seed from YC and CB Insights lists 500K total, both secondary, so no round recorded. The yespress.io page itself returned 403 on fetch; its claims come from search snippets. Founding year not stated. Website names Sandbox Technologies INC as the contact entity.
